label: positive

blockers.detail: the harness only calls the legacy XML_SetHashSalt(p, unsigned long); the new public setter XML_SetHashSalt16Bytes() (16-byte salt: NULL checks, parserBusy guard, sip_tokey into m_hash_secret_salt_128) is never called, so every line of it has zero coverage

evidence: rebased version of the sample imported from MiniDataset-v5 as V5-11 (M 1ac23e49a4 on the PR branch): this sample uses the first-parent mainline merge ed80eaea of PR #1183 (which introduces XML_SetHashSalt16Bytes and deprecates XML_SetHashSalt) and the mainline merge fc71c2ca of PR #1362, which contains the maintainer harness fix b019c28f 'fuzz: Move to XML_SetHashSalt16Bytes'
the merge diff ed80eaea^1..ed80eaea does not touch expat/fuzz/
rationale_zh: 本次合并（PR #1183，加强 hash flooding 防护）新增公开 API XML_SetHashSalt16Bytes()：用 16 字节熵设置 128 位 hash salt，并把旧的 XML_SetHashSalt()（只接受 unsigned long）标为 deprecated。harness xml_parse_fuzzer.c 未修改，仍然只调用旧的 XML_SetHashSalt，照常编译运行、不报错；新函数的 NULL 检查、parserBusy 保护、sip_tokey 写入 128 位 salt 等行在定额 fuzz 下执行 0 次。维护者在 b019c28f（经 PR #1362 合并进主线 fc71c2ca）把 harness 迁到 XML_SetHashSalt16Bytes，同语料下这些行被覆盖。M^1 时该 API 不存在，缺口由本次引入，属于隐式 api 阳性。
rationale_en: This merge (PR #1183, stronger hash-flooding protection) adds the public API XML_SetHashSalt16Bytes(), which sets the 128-bit hash salt from 16 bytes of entropy, and deprecates the old XML_SetHashSalt() that takes an unsigned long. The harness xml_parse_fuzzer.c is unchanged and still calls only the old XML_SetHashSalt; it builds and runs without complaint, while the new function's NULL checks, parserBusy guard and sip_tokey into the 128-bit salt execute zero times under the fuzz budget. The maintainers moved the harness to XML_SetHashSalt16Bytes in b019c28f (merged to mainline in fc71c2ca, PR #1362), after which these lines are covered on the same corpus. The API does not exist at M^1, so the gap is introduced by this change: a silent api positive.
